_comment: Everything the channel has MADE, independent of where it went.
This file exists because data/uploads.json only records attempts. An asset
that was rendered and then never posted anywhere leaves no trace there, so
the most expensive gap of all, a finished clip nobody published, was the
one thing the register could not show.
kind decides which platforms are expected to carry it:
episode  the long form cut. YouTube only.
short    a vertical cut. YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook.
post     the written announcement for an episode. LinkedIn and X.
